frontmatter.name: gitnexus-cli
frontmatter.description: Use when the user needs to run GitNexus CLI commands like analyze/index a repo, check status, clean the index, generate a wiki, or list indexed repos. Examples: \"Index this repo\", \"Reanalyze the codebase\", \"Generate a wiki\"

headings.text: analyze — Build or refresh the index
wiki — Generate documentation from the graph

frontmatter.name: gitnexus-debugging
frontmatter.description: Use when the user is debugging a bug, tracing an error, or asking why something fails. Examples: \"Why is X failing?\", \"Where does this error come from?\", \"Trace this bug\"

frontmatter.name: gitnexus-exploring
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks how code works, wants to understand architecture, trace execution flows, or explore unfamiliar parts of the codebase. Examples: \"How does X work?\", \"What calls this function?\", \"Show me the auth flow\"

frontmatter.name: gitnexus-guide
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks about GitNexus itself — available tools, how to query the knowledge graph, MCP resources, graph schema, or workflow reference. Examples: \"What GitNexus tools are available?\", \"How do I use GitNexus?\"

frontmatter.name: gitnexus-impact-analysis
frontmatter.description: Use when the user wants to know what will break if they change something, or needs safety analysis before editing code. Examples: \"Is it safe to change X?\", \"What depends on this?\", \"What will break?\"

headings.text: Example: "What breaks if I change validateUser?"

frontmatter.name: gitnexus-refactoring
frontmatter.description: Use when the user wants to rename, extract, split, move, or restructure code safely. Examples: \"Rename this function\", \"Extract this into a module\", \"Refactor this class\", \"Move this to a separate file\"
